items.q: Lewis...at the Erlanger--he liked it very much

ctx.x: Okay, you were saying Mickey Rooney and...

Oh, I said they used...every week, they...they'd be four, five people come down and listen to rehearsal, you know, and they all liked the show and everything but they...they uh...we just didn't happen to find any. Lewis...at the Erlanger--he liked it very much but just as we...we give a try-out of our show down at the old Mayan one night, and they...he was told about it, and he was...wanted the show. I got a letters from him in there, but he went back East and stayed three or four months, and when he come back,…
So when did you write your first screenplay? Because you've got five or six screenplays finished.
